promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-03 (caiso-160). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-03-nyiso160-ctmeter-screen-b (bundle results/calibration/nyiso160_ctmeter_screen_B). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, UNCHANGED. ZERO CONFIG DELTA and ZERO FREE PARAMETERS: the DOF ledger is carried verbatim at 30 entries / 6 residual. WHAT CHANGED IS AN INPUT, NOT A RECIPE -- the CONTENT of the measured CT heat-rate artifact the keeper already consumed (measured_ct_heat_rates=true since nyiso-89, carried in the prb_overrides channel). THE DEFECT (caiso-146 s2.4, fixed at f6238a5): derive_campd_ct_heat_rates.py declares a physical band [6.0, 25.0] MMBtu/MWh but applied it ONLY to the plant aggregate, so loaded hours at physically impossible rates -- a meter artifact, not generation behaviour -- were averaged into the plant rate and diluted it LOW. The screen now applies the module's OWN band per loaded hour and evaluates the _MIN_LOADED_HOURS trust gate on the in-band hours. No parameter moved. NYISO CARRIES THE LARGEST ARTIFACT MOVEMENT OF THE SIX ISOs and it is ONE-SIDED DEARER: cap-weighted 12.0769 -> 12.4355 (+0.3586), 17 plants dearer / 0 cheaper / 2 unchanged, 19/19 still applied, no flag changes, 80 -> 79 unit rows. Only Gowanus (15.2804 -> 16.9538) and Narrows (15.7537 -> 16.7814) move past 0.5 -- both NYC in-city CTs whose sub-6.0 loaded hours were diluting the meter. WHY THIS RUN EXISTED AT ALL: caiso-159 promoted this same correction into CAISO and NEISO but COULD NOT promote NYISO, because nyiso-113 promoted underneath the caiso-158 arms mid-flight, leaving that arm carrying nyiso_li_locational_reserve=False against a keeper that arms it. Promoting it would have dropped a PUBLISHED Zone-K reserve requirement to gain an input correction -- a rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] regression in the name of rule 14. This arm replays the nyiso-113 recipe itself (replay_keeper.py, NO --set), so the zero delta is STRUCTURAL rather than asserted, and the Zone-K ladder is carried forward intact (9 locational reserve families, 5 quick-start, confirmed in both arms' LP construction). GATES. K1 zero recipe changes. K2 CONTROL INTEGRITY, BIT-IDENTICAL: the control arm (2026-08-03-nyiso160-ctmeter-control) replays the same recipe at the SAME HEAD against the keeper's own pre-fix artifact and reproduces the committed nyiso113_lilocational_B at max |dMW| = 0.000000 on EVERY P1 class-hour of all three years (totals 147.1621/150.6234/151.7383 TWh to 4 dp). K3 liveness: CT_PEAKER -0.0121/-0.0047/-0.0359 TWh and lambda +0.030/+0.024/+0.079 % (2023/24/25) -- reproducing caiso-158's independent prediction of -0.012/-0.005/-0.036 TWh and +0.028/+0.020/+0.080 % almost exactly. K4 no criterion regresses: all 9 verdicts, the determination, the grade summary (9/8, 1 ledgered, 0 fails), the C1 headline (all 14/14, free 10/10) and the caveat list are IDENTICAL to the incumbent's. K5 span [2023, 2024, 2025], holdout freeze ACTIVE and untouched. A CONTROL ARM WAS SOLVED AGAINST THE HANDOFF'S INSTRUCTION, AND IT EARNED ITS COMPUTE. The caiso-159 handoff said none was needed because the committed keeper IS the control; that holds only if the keeper solved at this HEAD, and it did not -- seven src/market_sim commits landed after it, and caiso-146 had recorded a comparable run of documented-inert commits nonetheless leaving a keeper's sidecars diverging up to 3.2 GW on a class-hour. The control both (a) makes the A/B delta attributable to the artifact alone and (b) ANSWERS THE STANDING caiso-146 HEAD-DRIFT ITEM IN THE NEGATIVE FOR NYISO. REPORTED, NOT HIDDEN: config_drift flagged FOUR value diffs vs the keeper -- retirement_rule, entry_rate_limits, entry_commissioning_lag, caiso_ra_min_load_frac. None is a recipe choice by this session; every one is a SHIPPED DEFAULT that moved on main (24b1602, 3e33f15, a0fc302) after the keeper solved, recorded identically by BOTH arms. config_drift structurally cannot tell that apart from a real recipe change, so gen_caiso160_attestation.py adds a DEFAULT_MOVES allowlist that names each field, its commit and why it cannot reach a NYISO backcast (three are forecast-only capacity-evolution fields -- a backcast never runs the evolution loop; caiso_ra_min_load_frac was re-scoped to CAISO under rule 25 and sits behind a reader gate NYISO never opens) -- and the allowlist is honoured ONLY when the K2 bit-identity holds. One non-zero MW would void it. That is a NEW GENERAL DEFECT for the lane, not a NYISO quirk: any ISO promoted after a default move will hit it. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] / rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] govern in both directions -- the corrected input goes in because it is the corrected input, and it would equally have gone in had the residual worsened (PREREG s6 binding no-tuning clause). Rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE] satisfied: the re-derivation cites a meter defect, never a residual. Rule 28b: measured_ct_heat_rates keeps its existing per-ISO cell verdicts -- an INPUT CORRECTION with no mechanism surface, so no cell changes verdict. Evidence: PREREG-caiso160-nyiso-ct-heat-rate-rebase-2026-08-03.md, FINDING-caiso160-nyiso-ct-heat-rate-rebase-2026-08-03.md, FINDING-caiso158-ct-heat-rate-meter-screen-2026-08-03.md, FINDING-caiso159-ct-heat-rate-promotion-2026-08-03.md. PRIOR KEEPER: 2026-08-02-nyiso-113-li-locational, superseded not retracted -- its Zone-K locational reserve ladder, ramp-envelope and NYSDEC 227-3 mechanisms are all carried forward.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
